subject: ProcurePlus: Ariba/Coupa portal mapping + MSA redline questions (PO acknowledge SLA)
messages:
From: Megan Davis <megan.davis@procureplus.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: ariba-support@procureplus.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — questions on MSA redline + PO ack SLA

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood Dedicated offering yesterday. Our procurement team reviewed the MSA and a couple of items popped up that we need to align on before we kick off Ariba enrollment. I attached our internal mapping spreadsheet and a short summary of the asks. Key points: 

- PO acknowledgement SLA: our accounts payable requires a guaranteed PO ack within 2 business days for orders > $5k. Your standard orderflow seems to rely on buyer-system acks. Could Redwood provide either (a) a system-generated PO ack from your gateway or (b) an SLA exception documented in the order form?
- Invoice remittance field: Ariba expects a dedicated remittance field; in your Order Form we only see a generic invoicing contact. We need the 4-field remittance (remit-to name, remit-to address, remit-to email, remit-to GL) populated in registration.
- MSA redlines: legal flagged Section 6.2 (data retention) and 11.1 (liability cap carve-outs for POs routed via third-party marketplace). We attached a marked-up MSA (Redline_MSA_R3.docx).

Can you loop in whoever owns vendor portal mapping and the legal reviewer? We want to avoid holding the Ariba/channel activation while legal and engineering align.

Thanks,

Megan Davis
Head of Procurement, ProcurePlus
megan.davis@procureplus.com
+1 415 555 0142

Attachments: OrderForm_FieldProposal.csv (field mapping), Redline_MSA_R3.docx

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — questions on MSA redline + PO ack SLA

Megan — thanks for the clear summary and the files. Looping in Laura from Legal and Karthik from Integrations. Quick responses to your bullets below; Laura and Karthik will follow up with specifics.

- PO ack SLA: we typically honor a 3-business-day ack for portal-based POs; 2 days is doable for accounts with Dedicated capacity if we add an explicit Order Form clause and enable an automated ack notification on our gateway. We can draft an exception for the OF.
- Remittance fields: Karthik — is the Ariba/Coupa connector able to surface a 4-field remit block during vendor registration? If not, what’s the best workaround?
- MSA redlines: Laura — we’ll need a targeted response for the retention and liability carve-out items; can you propose counter-language?

Next step: Laura, can you provide a short memo with recommended language to include in a revised Order Form and a one-paragraph justification for the procurement team? Karthik, please capture the required mapping changes in a CSV I can share back with ProcurePlus.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, Megan Davis <megan.davis@procureplus.com>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding — questions on MSA redline + PO ack SLA

Markus / Megan,

I reviewed the Redline_MSA_R3.docx and flagged the relevant paragraphs. High-level positions and suggested edits below (summary rather than full clause copy):

1) Section 6.2 — Data retention: ProcurePlus requests a 5-year retention requirement for transaction logs and subset of KV cache for dispute resolution. Our standard stance: 13 months log retention and customer-controlled retention for KV cache. Suggested compromise language for OF: Redwood will retain transactional audit logs for 36 months and provide on-request extracts for longer-term archiving subject to additional fees and SOC controls. 

2) Section 11.1 — Liability cap carve-out for POs via marketplace: customer wants carve-out for gross negligence/third-party routing. We propose keeping the overall liability cap but adding explicit carve-outs for (a) proven gross negligence and (b) data breaches caused by Redwood third-party integrations where Redwood failed to implement industry-standard configurations. We will not accept an open-ended carve-out tied to "marketplace routing" without narrow definition.

3) Order Form SLA clause: I can draft an OF addendum that (a) enumerates the PO Ack SLA of 2 business days for orders > $5k conditioned on Dedicated capacity being active, and (b) includes the remit-field requirement for registration. That OF addendum will be shown as an attachment to the main Order Form (and mirrored in Ariba config notes).

I attached a short legal memo (pasted below is the one-paragraph justification for procurement). If ProcurePlus agrees to the compromise language, we can produce a redline-ready OF term and route the document via DocuSign.

Legal memo (one-paragraph for procurement):
Redwood proposes a balanced approach that shortens log retention to 36 months (from requested 60) to avoid operational cost increases while providing extract access for audit purposes; liability carve-outs will remain narrow and tied to established exceptions (gross negligence, proven misconfiguration of third-party connectors) to preserve commercial predictability. The Order Form will capture the PO acknowledgement SLA and vendor registration remit fields as a binding operational addendum, subject to Dedicated capacity activation.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments: PO_Ack_SLA_Table.xlsx (draft SLA matrix)

From: Megan Davis <megan.davis@procureplus.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — questions on MSA redline + PO ack SLA

Laura — thanks for the quick review and the memo. A few clarifying Qs from procurement before we proceed to redline: 

- The 36-month log retention—can you confirm that exports for audit will be provided in csv/xml on request and that typical turnaround is 10 business days?
- The Dedicated-capacity condition: if the customer is in a mixed deployment (some calls to Hosted API, some to Dedicated), will the 2-day SLA still apply to any POs routed to Redwood as the vendor? We need explicit language to avoid misinterpretation.

Also, we've copied our Ariba integration lead (ariba-support@procureplus.com) — they want to confirm the vendor registration mapping for remit fields and ask whether Redwood will accept remit-to-email as a required registration input or if it can be an optional contact field.

Happy to conference this if it's easier.

Best,
Megan

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: ariba-support@procureplus.com, megan.davis@procureplus.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 21 Aug 2025 11:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood onboarding — vendor remittance mapping + PO ack automation

Hi Megan / Ariba team,

Short answer on mapping capabilities and recommended config:

- Ariba/Coupa connector: our vendor onboarding pipeline supports custom field mapping. We can surface a required remit-to-email, remit-to-name, remit-to-address1/2, and remit-to-GL as discrete vendor attributes. In Ariba these map to ext:RemitEmail, ext:RemitName, ext:RemitAddressLine1, ext:RemitGL.
- Remit-to-email: we recommend making this required for ProcurePlus; without remit email automated remittance routing and invoice validations fail.
- PO acknowledgement automation: we can enable an outbound webhook from our gateway that triggers a system ack and marks the PO state as "ACK_SENT" within 1 business day provided the order passes schema validation. To meet the 2-business-day SLA for orders > $5k we'll set processing priority and an alert route to our operations team if validation fails.

I'll attach a quick CSV mapping (OrderForm_FieldProposal.csv updated) showing field->ariba-key mappings. Operational notes: if ProcurePlus expects guaranteed 2-day ack irrespective of validation, we need a contract-level exception where Redwood accepts responsibility for simple schema errors on inbound POs for a 90-day onboarding period.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Integrations
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Megan Davis <megan.davis@procureplus.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Proposed path forward + DocuSign route

Megan — thanks to you, Laura, and Karthik for the quick cadence. Proposed path to avoid blocking Ariba activation: 

1) Redwood to produce: (a) Order Form addendum with PO Ack SLA (2 business days for orders > $5k conditioned on Dedicated capacity), (b) remit-field contract language that makes remit-to-email required during vendor registration, and (c) the SLA exception language for the 90-day onboarding validation responsibility.
2) ProcurePlus to confirm: acceptance of the 36-month audit log retention with 10-business-day export SLA and agreement to test a sample of 10 POs during onboarding.
3) Sign and route via DocuSign: we will upload the Order Form addendum and the marked MSA counter (Laura will prepare). Link: https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/ABC123456789

If ProcurePlus confirms (2) by EOD Wednesday 27 Aug we will prepare the DocuSign package and schedule the Ariba registration slot for the week of Sep 8.

Action items assigned: 
- Laura: final redline and OF addendum (target Aug 26, evening).
- Karthik: final CSV mapping and onboarding playbook (target Aug 26).
- Markus: prepare DocuSign package and Ops preflight.

Markus Klein
